So when you do a search on startpage.com, you're connected to startpage, and startpage is making the query to google on your behalf. You're basically getting google search results without having to directly communicate with google. Startpage is the middle man, and it doesn't tell google who is searching.

Startpage also allows you to proxy into the websites that show up in the search results. Same deal, they'll communicate with the website on your behalf without telling that website about you. Try it out, sometime.

A VPN is a form of a proxy, but a VPN is much more encompassing. A VPN basically acts as a proxy for all your internet traffic, not just your web browser.

Feel free to ask any questions if you're confused about anything.
